title: Working theory (race condition) upgraded to confirmed via repro evidence
notes: Tests the OTHER direction from fx49/fx50: a hypothesis that DOES get confirmed within the same session, via concrete repro evidence. A good extractor should capture the final CONFIRMED state, ideally also noting it started as an unconfirmed theory.

turns.text: The flaky test might be a race condition between the writer and the indexer — that's my working theory, not confirmed.
Not reliably. Actually hold on — I just added a sleep before the assertion and it passed 50/50 times. That's pretty strong evidence it IS a race condition now, not just a theory.
Good, so it's moved from a hypothesis to a confirmed race condition given the sleep-based repro evidence.

gold_atoms.text: The flaky test's root cause moved from a working THEORY (possible race condition between the writer and indexer) to CONFIRMED, once a sleep-before-assertion fix passed 50/50 repro runs.
